incidente.resumo: On December 17 (PST), one Availability Zone of AWS SA-EAST-1 lost utility power; one backup generator became unavailable when its breaker opened and a second failed mechanically, so the remaining generators were overloaded and shut down. The team bypassed a malfunctioning automated control system and brought generators online manually, then instances recovered. A bad network configuration introduced during recovery degraded connectivity in both Availability Zones for 20 minutes until the device was taken out of service.
servicos_afetados: Instances in one SA-EAST-1 Availability Zone
Internet connectivity for both SA-EAST-1 Availability Zones

gatilho.texto: On December 17th at 10:05PM PST, the Availability Zone lost utility power due to a fault at the local utility provider's substation.
trechos: On December 17th at 10:05PM PST, the impacted Availability Zone lost utility power due to a fault that happened at the substation of the local utility provider.

descricao.texto: During the failover to generator power, a breaker in front of one generator opened and a second generator independently failed due to a mechanical issue; the remaining healthy generators could not handle the load and also shut down. Forensics on the breaker opening and the mechanical failure were not completed.
trechos: In this particular case when we experienced a loss in utility power, the load switched over to our backup generators as designed.
During that failover a breaker in front of one of the generators opened, rendering that generator unavailable.
Shortly thereafter, a second generator independently failed due to a mechanical issue.
The loss of utility power combined with the unavailability of two additional generators meant that there was more load in the facility than the remaining healthy generators could handle.
With more load on them than they could support, the remaining healthy generators also shut down.
While we have not completed forensics on the breaker opening and the generator mechanical failure

fatores_contribuintes.texto: The facility uses an automated control system to aggregate power from multiple generators. The team experienced several additional setbacks bringing the power infrastructure back online and eventually identified that this system was not functioning properly; it was then bypassed and generators were brought online manually, a slow process.
trechos: This facility uses an automated control system which allows it to aggregate power from multiple generators together.
The team experienced several additional setbacks when trying to bring the power infrastructure back online, and eventually identified that the automated control system wasn’t functioning properly.
Once the team identified the issue, they bypassed the automated control system and began the slow process of manually bringing the generators online.

fatores_contribuintes.texto: A second mechanism during recovery: a network technician brought a network device up manually with a bad configuration, which advertised an invalid route and degraded Internet connectivity for both Availability Zones for a total of 20 minutes.
trechos: instances in both Availability Zones did experience a total of 20 minutes of degraded network connectivity due to an error that was made in bringing our network back online once power was restored.
As part of the recovery process, a network technician brought a network device up manually in the power-impacted Availability Zone and introduced a bad configuration.
That misconfiguration led to the device advertising an invalid network route when it came back online, which resulted in degraded Internet connectivity for both SA-EAST-1 Availability Zones.

passos.texto: The facilities team began working to bring the failed generators back online.
trechos: Our facilities team immediately began working to bring the failed generators back online.

passos.texto: The team bypassed the automated control system and manually brought the generators online; once generator capacity was sufficient, all impacted instances were recovered.
trechos: Once the team identified the issue, they bypassed the automated control system and began the slow process of manually bringing the generators online.
Once there was sufficient generator capacity to fully support the facility, all of the impacted instances were recovered.

passos.texto: The misconfigured network device was taken out of service, restoring full connectivity to the Region.
trechos: Once we understood the issue, we took the device out of service and full connectivity to the Region was restored.

passos.texto: After power and networking were fully restored, all services were brought back online and full customer access was restored.
trechos: After power and networking were fully restored to the facility, all of our services were brought back online and full customer access was restored.

acoes.texto: AWS will take steps to ensure this Availability Zone in Brazil is better able to withstand a similar power failure.
trechos: will take steps to ensure this Availability Zone in Brazil is better able to withstand a similar power failure in the future.

perguntas_em_aberto: Forensics on the breaker opening and the generator mechanical failure had not been completed when the summary was published.

observacoes: The year comes from the summary's publication date (December 20, 2013), three days after the event. The extracted text repeats the whole summary in Portuguese; trechos were taken from the English part.
